name: knowledgevoice
description: KnowledgeVoice - single Vercel project (React/Vite frontend + Express API as Vercel Functions). voice-agent/ is a separate long-running worker, deployed independently.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
